title: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!
description:
A deep dive into the untold daily lives and the inter-school interactions of the Ooarai Girls' team and the other students (along with the colorful characters that surround them) who are wholeheartedly dedicated to the way of the tank!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The series had a four-part theatrical pre-screening in Japan starting in December 2025. Regular TV broadcast began in October 2026.

• Part 1 releasing theatrically on December 26, 2025.
• Part 2 releasing theatrically on January 30, 2026.
• Part 3 releasing theatrically on March 6, 2026.
• Part 4 releasing theatrically on April 10, 2026.
